name: strobe-talbott-foia
description: Static GitHub Pages site for FOIA case F-2017-13804

scripts.build:sample: python3 scripts/build_site.py && python3 scripts/build_chunks.py && python3 scripts/build_semantic_index.py
scripts.build:site: python3 scripts/build_site.py --manifest data/manifest.json --out site && python3 scripts/build_chunks.py --manifest data/manifest.json --out site/assets/search/chunks.json && python3 scripts/build_semantic_index.py --chunks site/assets/search/chunks.json --out site/assets/search/semantic_index.json
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:search
